dataset: Observed ADS-B / readsb sample trace for DAL1812
provenance_note: The local fixture copies selected exact coordinates, timestamps and flight-state values from the upstream readsb trace. It does not contain all upstream samples. The trace begins mid-flight and therefore must not be presented as full-route observational coverage.
route_context_note: Contemporary flight-schedule sources identify DL1812 as Liberia (LIR) to Minneapolis (MSP); that schedule context is supporting context and does not convert the partial readsb sample into complete observed coverage.
